name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 Lightning 4-step
means: The same 4-step-at-cfg-1.0 trick for the Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 checkpoint - the model behind every reference-conditioned keyframe and every turnaround view.
note: metadata ABSENT. base_model is INFERRED FROM THE FILENAME ONLY, and this is the weakest provenance on any card in this library - read the next sentence before trusting it. This file and Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-Lightning-4steps are architecturally IDENTICAL in the header: 849,608,296 bytes each, 2160 tensors, 720 modules, rank 64, alpha 8, bare transformer_blocks.0..59. Nothing inside either file distinguishes 2509 from 2511. They were hashed and they are genuinely different weights (this one 22226e8d..., the 2509 one 2a32ce93...), so they are not a duplicated download - but IF THE TWO FILENAMES HAD EVER BEEN SWAPPED, no tool in this project could detect it. Only a render could. | Wired at strength 1.0 in workflows 14, 22, 23 and 32, i.e. it is in the chain for the reference-keyframe path and the turnaround path both. | Same negative-prompt caveat as the t2i Lightning: at cfg 1.0 the negative is nearly ignored. | status untested for the same reason as its t2i sibling - it demonstrably produces images (the 16 views in studio/samples/cast/VIRO/ came through it) but no 4-step-against-20-step pair has ever been rendered and looked at, so nothing is known about what the speed costs. | Alpha 8 over rank 64 = scale 0.125.
